milestone: Native task/note Print and PDF output
status: Implemented in both owned apps; scoped phone/tablet native flows accepted. Mac native/error/account/VoiceOver gates and other rank-3 work remain open.
entry_points: Task list Task options → Print or save PDF
Pinned note → Print or save PDF
Mac task-list Print action also offers Command-P
behavior: Captures current matching list with its actual ordering, groups and collapsed content; no screenshot export
A4/US Letter, optional notes and complete nested checklists in a separate native Options sheet
Read-only immutable review; workspace binding and current source equality checked before export or print
Native PDFKit preview, system file save and system Print panels; no job is sent automatically
Rendered settings must match current options before Save/Print enables; async rendering is cancellable
Source/workspace changes hide output and dismiss options/export/print presentations
Pinned note exports its own complete note without unrelated checklist content
Account IDs, record IDs, discussions, attachments and credentials are not included; names are resolved from available project/label/assignee data

renderer.text: Selectable vector text, styled inline notes, complete raw fallback, code, headings and web destinations printed as text; no HTML/image/page fetch. Paragraph/span tags carry actual text; no PDF/UA conformance claim.
renderer.pagination: Whole short paragraphs/blocks, heading chains kept with first body paragraph, long paragraph continuation, repeated title and Page N of M footer. Measurement is bounded to page height rather than repeatedly measuring the full remaining note.
renderer.unicode: Arabic glyph-to-Unicode fallback corrected with Geeza Pro; native iPhone/iPad saved files verify Arabic, Japanese, accented text, emoji, link and final instruction.
renderer.limit_behavior: Explicit refusal, never an intentionally truncated/partial successful export

coverage: Source grouping/order, unique task count, metadata and exclusion of internal/discussion data
Optional nested checklists and note-only export
36-section Unicode/code note on both paper sizes with every section/final sentinel, footer and media box
No orphan heading at page end
500 repetitions of every source word preserved across one long paragraph
500-page refusal before a successful partial result

core.execution_host: SwiftPM suites execute on macOS. Separate iPhone/iPad Simulator saved-file proofs verify the actual iOS renderer.

visual_qa.method: Native renderer produces seven A4 and seven Letter pages; every page inspected after Poppler rendering. Final bounded-layout output is pixel-identical to the fully inspected version. Both pages of the actual iPhone saved PDF are inspected; actual tablet output is pixel-identical.
initial_findings: PDFKit reversed numeral-only footer reading order; now Page N of M
System Arabic fallback lost selectable characters; explicit native fallback fixes extraction
A short heading orphaned before its paragraph on US Letter; whole-chain lookahead now keeps them together
Largest-text main settings crowded the tablet preview; settings moved to their own native sheet

native_iphone.result: Three distinct native cases accepted across two final-source runs. v5 actual Save/readback/relaunch and largest-text Options/Print Cancel pass; the initial row-center toggle tap failed. v6 targets the real thumb and the same options/save Cancel/relaunch case passes. Do not describe the full v5 bundle as passed.
native_iphone.saved_data: Entire persisted snapshot compared canonically before/after output and normal relaunch; every field preserved. Local Documents output is removed only after its synthetic contents are verified.

native_ipad.result: Actual local PDF Save/readback/relaunch; largest-text separate Options and native Print panel Cancel; content/paper changes and real sidebar Cancel with exact canonical snapshot preservation. All pass.
native_ipad.visual: Final main/Options panels inspected at largest text; controls readable. Saved file matches the reviewed phone output pixel-for-pixel.

native_mac.result: Final owned isolated app builds (mac-p2-print-final-build-v2.log); strict deep signature passes. Actual signed app includes sandbox, printing and user-selected read/write entitlements. Native Mac Save/Print and VoiceOver remain pending; CUA directly reports locked Mac.
native_mac.entitlements: Production app and future isolated Mac test apps declare com.apple.security.print; extensions do not receive printer access.

limits: Mac hands-on Save/Print and VoiceOver; physical printer delivery; native source/account-switch/in-flight invalidation and denied/save-failure UI acceptance remain open
No release/distribution, remote reminders, old-client enforcement or genuine calendar-provider acceptance claim
Share-capture remaining acceptance, view/gesture controls, hierarchy grammar and other backlog ranks remain open

cleanup.main_apps: All main Taskfold test apps closed after teardown; required installed widget host retained.

final_builds.signatures: Both final isolated build products pass strict deep signature verification. This is development-build verification, not distribution acceptance.
final_builds.ios_build_product_note: After alternating device test destinations, the shared iOS build product had a changed Assets.car seal. Only the owned containing-app build output was regenerated from cached objects; the final normal app build and strict deep verification pass. No source asset or app data changed.
